module: Road marking paint style for a region. For now only one region is defined: USA (right-hand traffic). Provides the materials and widths of center, lane, edge, stop and give-way lines, as well as of the hatched separation zone.
notes: The give-way line (shark teeth) does not exist as a DecalRoad material: it is a solid white bar.
getRegion ignores any argument and always returns the USA table.

getRegion.desc: Returns the marking style table of the current region (always USA): centerLineMaterial, centerLineWidthM, centerLineTexLen, laneLineMaterial, edgeLineMaterial, leftEdgeLineMaterial, stopLineMaterial, giveWayMaterial, stopLineWidthM, giveWayWidthM, goreSepMaterial, goreSepTexLen.

returns.desc: Style table (materials as strings, widths and texture lengths in meters).
